# mixed.de

> > A mixed-content aggregation site combining TV Guide entertainment listings, streaming recommendations (Netflix, Peacock, HBO), dictionary references (Cambridge Dictionary, Wiktionary), and USDA nutrition resources.

This site appears to aggregate diverse content types including TV schedules and streaming guides for major platforms, multilingual dictionary entries, and government nutrition materials. The content spans entertainment news, language reference, and public health information.

## Key Topics

- Netflix
- TV Guide
- Cambridge Dictionary
- streaming-guide
- tv-listings

- Yellowstone

## TV Listings & Schedules

- [TV Guide - Home](https://tvguide.com): Homepage: streaming recommendations, reviews & entertainment news
- [TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV listings & channel information for shows, movies & programs
- [Live Sports On TV Today](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, NCAA & UEFA matches
- [Winter TV Guide 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter 2025-2026 TV preview with streaming guides
- [Cary, NC TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV listings for Cary, NC antenna & cable providers

## Streaming Recommendations

- [Best Shows on Netflix (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of top 55 Netflix shows including Vladimir & Bridgerton
- [Best Movies on Netflix (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Top 61 Netflix movies featuring Jurassic World Rebirth & Oscar nominees
- [Best Movies on Peacock (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-peacock): Top 16 Peacock movies including Oscar nominees Hamnet & Bugonia
- [New Shows Winter 2026](https://tvguide.com/galleries/the-new-shows-of-the-2025-2026-winter-tv-season): Gallery of new winter 2026 shows from Game of Thrones & Star Trek
- [Marshals - Yellowstone Spin-Off](https://tvguide.com/news/y-marshals-cbs-yellowstone-spin-off-release-date-trailer-cast): Marshals spinoff details: Kayce Dutton in new CBS procedural drama

## Dictionary & Language Reference

- [Cambridge Dictionary - 'About' (English)](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/about): Cambridge Dictionary English definition & usage for 'about'
- [Cambridge Dictionary - 'About' (Chinese)](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/zhs/词典/英语-汉语-简体/about): Cambridge Dictionary English-Chinese definition entry for 'about'
- [Dictionary.com - 'About'](https://dictionary.com/browse/about): Dictionary.com definition entry for 'about' with usage examples
- [Wiktionary - 'About'](https://en.m.wiktionary.org/wiki/about): Wiktionary entry with etymology & linguistic details for 'about'
- [iCIBA Online Translation](https://iciba.com/word): Chinese-English translation dictionary with 177 language support

## Optional

- [Nutrition.gov - Printable Materials](https://nutrition.gov/topics/basic-nutrition/printable-materials-and-handouts): Printable handouts, fact sheets & recipes from USDA & FDA partners
